name: Bridge Studies Between Fields
title: Bridge Studies Between Fields
answer: Bridge studies between fields are research works that connect two or more disciplines by tracing how methods, findings or vocabulary move from one to the other. In citation mapping they appear as papers that cite across community boundaries, and they are often the point where a technique from one field is first tested in another. The scope covers both deliberate reviews that compare fields and ordinary papers whose reference lists happen to span them.

crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

sections.body: Bridge studies between fields are research works that connect two or more disciplines by tracing how methods, findings or vocabulary move from one to the other. In citation mapping they appear as papers that cite across community boundaries, and they are often the point where a technique from one field is first tested in another. The scope covers both deliberate reviews that compare fields and ordinary papers whose reference lists happen to span them.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.body: The work runs on citation indexes and bibliographic databases that record who cites whom, together with the metadata that labels each paper with a field.Graph software and network libraries handle the storage and traversal of the citation links.
sections.heading: What it runs on

sections.body: A typical study builds a citation graph, assigns each node to a field, and then looks for edges that cross between fields. Researchers measure bridge strength with counts, co-citation, bibliographic coupling or betweenness, and they often read the bridging papers to see what actually travelled. Validation usually means checking a sample of the detected bridges by hand against the original papers rather than a search tool.
sections.heading: How the work is done

sections.body: Field labels come from publisher metadata, journal categories or author keywords, and each source carries its own bias and lag. Citation counts favour older and English language work, so a bridge can look stronger or weaker than it is, and the underlying records are licensed by the databases that hold them. Because content here links to the original paper and not to the Consensus search tool, readers can check the source directly, and any claim about a bridge should be traceable to the cited works.
sections.heading: Rights, risk and provenance

sections.body: Expect finer field labels, fuller coverage of non journal outputs such as preprints and conference papers, and more use of full text to see what a citation actually carries. Bridge detection is likely to move from static snapshots toward time resolved maps that show when a connection formed and whether it held. The open questions are how to compare bridges across fields fairly and how to keep the maps current as new work appears.
